policy.timing: Parent wall around GNU-time-supervised fresh compiler process; includes startup, source read, parse/lower/codegen/link and Wasm output I/O. No Wasm-to-native compilation, instantiation or JavaScript execution.
policy.artifacts: Scriptw build wasm emits P and its Cargo-built Portable shared R sidecar; R extraction/admission/copy/write costs included each process, Rust/Cargo R production excluded. Scriptc links its prebuilt runtime into standalone WASI Wasm; runtime-pack production excluded.
policy.cache: Fresh per-process work/source/application cache/tmp/Zig-local directories; Scriptc SCRIPTC_NO_CACHE=1. OS page caches and existing Zig global toolchain cache retained, never flushed. This is cold application/compiler-process startup, not a cold machine/toolchain installation.
policy.memory: GNU time compiler-child lifetime high-water RSS, including accounted descendants; not simultaneous aggregate process-tree RSS, runtime RSS or live heap.
policy.source: Original17 exact source/expected bytes retained; Scriptc alone receives the canonical print-to-console.log adapter.
policy.compiler_identity: Scriptw source_commit is the embedded base Git revision; source_fingerprint and executable SHA identify the measured working-tree compiler. The performance evidence separately binds its source patch and publication.
policy.statistics: Two blocks, ABBA per case with alternating first actor; second block reverses cases and actors. Four fresh builds per compiler/case; pooled and both block medians. Descriptive observations, no significance/conformance claim.
policy.resources: Sequential children, one CPU, at most4GiB cgroup, no swap, grouped OOM; native/module caches unused by build wasm.
policy.validation: Successful compilation and portable Wasm magic checked, emitted bytes retained; no output execution/checksum verification in this compilation-only measurement.
